spec.name: Furniture Boo Ghost Trio
spec.description: Three friendly ivory sheet ghosts of different heights share a low charcoal plinth with a tiny orange pumpkin. Rounded stepped crowns, dangling cloth hems and painted oval faces create a compact survival-server decoration. Front faces negative Z; all geometry fits within 32×16×16.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: three different-height friendly sheet ghosts clustered on a discreet dark base with black oval eyes and tiny open mouths, stepped cloth hems and one tiny orange pumpkin. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..32, y=0..16, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Standing on floor y=0. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
